adaptive.title: Adaptive
adaptive.description: Set a max-width on your container elements with the Adaptive Sass mixin, for layouts that step between fixed widths rather than flowing between them.

after.title: After
after.description: The After Sass mixin is an easy way to use the ::after CSS pseudo-element. You can insert text or design elements after the content of each selected element.

all-buttons.title: All Buttons
all-buttons.description: The All Buttons Sass mixin helps you target all the HTML button elements in the DOM, so you can easily apply your style rules.

all-text-inputs.title: All Text Inputs
all-text-inputs.description: The All Text Inputs Sass mixin helps you target all the text-based HTML input elements in the DOM, so you can easily apply your style rules.

antialias.title: Antialias
antialias.description: The Antialias Sass mixin draws text with greyscale antialiasing instead of subpixel antialiasing on macOS, which makes it look thinner. Measured in all three browsers.

aspect-ratio.title: Aspect Ratio
aspect-ratio.description: The Aspect Ratio Sass mixin holds an element to a ratio and adds what the CSS aspect-ratio property leaves out. It replaces Ratio Box and Responsive Video.

auto-grid.title: Auto Grid
auto-grid.description: The Auto Grid Sass mixin lays out as many columns as the container holds, with a minimum that never overflows a narrow screen, and an optional ceiling on the column count.

background-image.title: Background Image
background-image.description: The Background Image Sass mixin puts an image behind an element with cover, center and no-repeat, and a colour or a gradient over it as a filter.

background-pattern.title: Background Pattern
background-pattern.description: Seventeen background patterns from one line of Sass: dots, stripes, grid, checkerboard, crosshatch, zigzag, triangles, brick, waves, houndstooth, gingham, harlequin, sunburst, concentric, glow, vignette and mesh, all drawn with CSS gradients.

before.title: Before
before.description: The Before Sass mixin is an easy way to use the ::before CSS pseudo-element. You can insert text or design elements before the content of each selected element.

border-box.title: Border Box
border-box.description: The Border Box Sass mixin sets the box-sizing CSS property to border-box for the selected HTML elements.

border-radius.title: Border Radius
border-radius.description: Round an element's corners with the Border Radius Sass mixin. Pass one value for all four corners, or the CSS shorthand to set each corner apart.

brand-logo.title: Brand Logo
brand-logo.description: The Brand Logo Sass mixin helps you create an SEO-friendly logo component for your brand's website using CSS best practices.

breakpoint.title: Breakpoint
breakpoint.description: The Breakpoint Sass mixin helps you create scalable media queries and breakpoints using the @media CSS at-rule in SCSS.

breakpointer.title: Breakpointer
breakpointer.description: The Breakpointer Sass mixin is a handy little tool that shows which breakpoint you are at, so you can write your styles for that specific device.

center.title: Center
center.description: The Center Sass mixin allows you to center selected elements on both the horizontal and vertical axes using absolute positioning in CSS and Sass.

circle.title: Circle
circle.description: The Circle Sass mixin helps you create a perfect circle shape in CSS and Sass.

columnizer.title: Columnizer
columnizer.description: The Columnizer Sass mixin helps you create beautiful, responsive, card-based design layouts in CSS and Sass.

container.title: Container
container.description: The Container Sass mixin marks an element as a query container, so container-query can ask about its width instead of the viewport's.

container-query.title: Container Query
container-query.description: The Container Query Sass mixin writes a @container rule with the same arguments as breakpoint, so a component answers its container, not the viewport.

counter.title: Counter
counter.description: Number the children of any element with the Counter Sass mixin: steps, rankings, chapters and search results, continued across content or started at any number, with no classes in the markup.

escape-to-parent.title: Escape to Parent
escape-to-parent.description: The Escape to Parent Sass mixin writes a nested rule again with a theme or state class attached to its outermost element, so a class higher up the page can switch what the rule does.

except.title: Except
except.description: The Except Sass mixin helps you apply style changes to every element in a list except the ones you choose. It uses the :not() CSS pseudo-class.

focus-ring.title: Focus Ring
focus-ring.description: Draw a keyboard focus ring with the Focus Ring Sass mixin: an outline on :focus-visible, which stays out of the way of mouse users and survives forced-colors mode.

font-face.title: Font Face
font-face.description: The Font Face Sass mixin helps you generate a cross-browser compatible @font-face CSS at-rule in CSS and SCSS.

glass.title: Glass
glass.description: The Glass Sass mixin writes a frosted glass panel with backdrop-filter, the prefixed property older Safari needs and the opaque fallback a browser without support has to fall back to.

gradient.title: Gradient
gradient.description: Write linear, radial and conic CSS gradients with one Sass mixin, repeating or not, and choose the colour space they blend in.

hide.title: Hide
hide.description: Hide an element visually while keeping it available to screen readers, with the Hide Sass mixin, or keep it hidden until it has keyboard focus, for skip links.

loadify.title: Loadify
loadify.description: Fade a page element in as the page loads with the Loadify Sass mixin, which also gives images a smooth loading effect of their own.

long-shadow.title: Long Shadow
long-shadow.description: The Long Shadow Sass mixin draws the long shadow of flat design with box-shadow, stacking a copy of the element for every step of the length, in any direction and with an optional fade.

motion-safe.title: Motion Safe
motion-safe.description: Make animation opt-in with the Motion Safe Sass mixin: it applies motion only for users who have not asked their system for less, through prefers-reduced-motion.

only.title: Only
only.description: Target an element by its position among siblings of the same tag with the Only Sass mixin, which writes :first-of-type, :last-of-type and :nth-of-type.

placeholder.title: Placeholder
placeholder.description: The Placeholder Sass mixin helps you style the placeholder text in an input or textarea element and generate cross-browser compatible CSS code.

placeholder-shown.title: Placeholder Shown
placeholder-shown.description: Style an input or textarea while it is showing placeholder text, with the Placeholder Shown Sass mixin and the :placeholder-shown pseudo-class.

position.title: Position
position.description: The Position Sass mixin provides a one-line method to quickly set both the position and the offset properties of a selected element.

remove.title: Remove
remove.description: Set display to none with the Remove Sass mixin, and combine it with media queries to drop an element out of the document flow at chosen widths.

reset-css.title: Reset CSS
reset-css.description: The Reset CSS Sass mixin writes a modern baseline: border-box, sane line heights, media that does not overflow, form controls that inherit the page's font, and no specificity of its own.

reset-figure.title: Reset Figure
reset-figure.description: The Reset Figure Sass mixin helps you reset the margin values of figure elements to zero and make the img element inside them responsive.

resizable.title: Resizable
resizable.description: The Resizable Sass mixin helps you make an element resizable in both the horizontal and vertical directions.

responsive-image.title: Responsive Image
responsive-image.description: The Responsive Image Sass mixin fits an image to its container without upscaling it, and keeps its proportions against a height attribute.

reveal.title: Reveal
reveal.description: The Reveal Sass mixin animates something in and out of the page: a popover, a dialog, or an element a class toggles, with the starting-style and allow-discrete pieces that each fail silently on their own.

scissors.title: Scissors
scissors.description: Cut the corners off an element with the Scissors Sass mixin. One line sets the size of the cut and picks which corners it applies to.

screen-agent.title: Screen Agent
screen-agent.description: The Screen Agent Sass mixin helps you target elements based on different screen resolutions.

sizer.title: Sizer
sizer.description: The Sizer Sass mixin helps you size elements with one statement (or two). Size elements or create squares and rectangles very easily.

smartphone.title: Smartphone
smartphone.description: There will be times when you need to style elements for one particular smartphone model only. The Smartphone Sass mixin helps you do that.

sprite.title: Sprite
sprite.description: The Sprite Sass mixin helps you apply background images to the selected elements using the CSS sprite technique.

stretched-link.title: Stretched Link
stretched-link.description: The Stretched Link Sass mixin helps you make any HTML element clickable by stretching a nested link across its entire area.

tablet.title: Tablet
tablet.description: There will be times when you need to style elements for one particular tablet model only. The Tablet Sass mixin helps you do that.

text-gradient.title: Text Gradient
text-gradient.description: Add a gradient overlay to text with the Text Gradient Sass mixin. One line sets the direction of the gradient, the colours and the colour stops.

text-image.title: Text Image
text-image.description: The Text Image Sass mixin helps you clip the background image of a selected element to the shape of its foreground text.

text-selection.title: Text Selection
text-selection.description: The Text Selection Sass mixin helps you style the portion of text (or an element) that a user has selected.

text-shadow.title: Text Shadow
text-shadow.description: Add shadows to text with the Text Shadow Sass mixin. Each shadow is a direction or an angle, a colour and a distance, and it can be filled into a long shadow.

text-stroke.title: Text Stroke
text-stroke.description: Outline text with the Text Stroke Sass mixin: around the letter, straddling it, or with the letter left unfilled, in one line of Sass.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Write a Sass map out as CSS custom properties with the Tokens Sass mixin: a prefix, null values left out, quoted strings kept, and names a browser would drop refused.

triangle.title: Triangle
triangle.description: The Triangle Sass mixin helps you generate triangles using the ::before or ::after CSS pseudo-elements.

truncate.title: Truncate
truncate.description: Truncate text with the Truncate Sass mixin: one line with an ellipsis, or several with a clamp. The line count picks the technique and writes every declaration it needs.
